### Python notebook exercises

To work on one of the marimo Python notebooks below in molab:

1.  Go to [marimo's molab website](https://molab.marimo.io)
    and make sure you are logged into your account
2.  Click the link below to open the notebook in marimo's molab
3.  Once the notebook opens in molab, at the top of the page, click the green
    "Fork" button and confirm on the pop-up screen by clicking "Fork notebook."
    Do ***NOT*** click the dropdown next to the "Fork" button.

-   [Exercise 4: Intro to Python & marimo notebooks](https://molab.marimo.io/github/phyletica/intro-to-comp-bio/blob/main/notebooks/nb-01-intro-to-python/intro_python_marimo.py) [![Open in molab](https://marimo.io/molab-shield.svg)](https://molab.marimo.io/github/phyletica/intro-to-comp-bio/blob/main/notebooks/nb-01-intro-to-python/intro_python_marimo.py)
